title: Registration closes today
subtitle: November 3 election · Official Travis County deadline-day options
alt: Deadline-day submission guidance for Monday, October 5, 2026: take a completed application to a Travis County tax office; the Nelda Wells Spears Building at 2433 Ridgepoint Drive has special hours from 8 a.m. to midnight today only; or mail an application postmarked October 5 or earlier. The county recommends requesting a manual postmark at the postal counter.

events.label: Deliver a completed registration application
events.note: Check the county notice for each tax office’s hours

events.label: Special hours at 2433 Ridgepoint Drive
events.note: October 5 only · Nelda Wells Spears Building

events.label: Mail: request a manual postmark at the counter
events.note: Dropping a form in a collection box may mean a later postmark
